citations.S1: builds SQL by string interpolation from HTTP-request-controlled values (`user_id`, `status`)
citations.S3: sqlite returns the `id` column as an `int`; `"Order #" + order[0]` raises `TypeError: can only concatenate str`
citations.S4: makes `total / len(orders)` raise `ZeroDivisionError`, crashing the handler
citations.S5: float arithmetic isn't exact for currency (`0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3`), so totals/discounts can be off by fractions of a cent
citations.S6: No check that `0 <= pct <= 100`. A negative `pct` increases the price silently
citations.S7: check against an allowlist (`{"pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled", ...}`) before querying
citations.S11: propagates raw out of the function into the HTTP handler, likely surfacing an internal stack trace / file path to the client... raise/return a sanitized error at the API boundary
citations.S12: round once at the display boundary with a stated policy
citations.S14: Fragile positional tuple access... use `row_factory = sqlite3.Row`
